title: key-encoding-query-params
description: Query parameters that choose how returned keys are encoded

key_encoding.description: `hex` returns a private key as `key` and the public key as `didDocumentKey.publicKeyMultibase`. `jwk` returns a private key as `jwk` and the public key as `didDocumentKey.publicKeyJwk`. Hex carries no curve, so keys on any curve other than secp256k1 are always returned as JWK.
